title: DeepResearchBudget
description: The envelope `deep-research --print-budget` writes on stdout (exit 0), discriminated by `type: "deep_research_budget"`. One schema per `type` value, so an agent can route mechanically: the budget REFUSAL is a different discriminator (`deep_research_error`) and lives in `deep-research-error.schema.json`. v1.0.3 first shipped both shapes here behind a `oneOf`, which meant this file claimed the `deep_research_error` discriminator while covering only one of its four shapes — see GAP-SCHEMA-OVERLOADED-DISCRIMINATOR-001. English-only: these keys are budget diagnostics, not search-result fields, and the payload is serialized with `payload.to_string()`, which bypasses the wire-key mapper, so `--wire-keys pt` leaves them alone.

estimate_seconds.description: Alias of `wall_estimate_seconds`, kept for pre-1.0.2 consumers.

work_estimate_seconds.description: Total work if run serially, before parallelism is applied.

wall_estimate_seconds.description: Expected wall-clock duration at the resolved parallelism.

gated_seconds.description: Wall estimate plus `margin_percent`. This is the number the gate compares against.

suggested_global_timeout.description: Value to pass to `--global-timeout` for this load on this host.

shell_timeout_hint.description: Value for the OUTER shell `timeout`, above the CLI's own budget so the wrapper never fires first.

contention_factor_percent.description: Multiplier applied for Chrome contention, as a percentage; 100 means no scaling.

chrome_n.description: Chrome-like processes alive when the estimate was taken. Host state, so it varies run to run.

dual_vertical.description: Both web and news verticals are in play (`--no-news` turns this off).

runtime_dual_multiproc.description: The resolved parallelism actually allows the two verticals to run concurrently.

global_timeout_seconds.description: `--global-timeout` as requested, before any contention raise.

effective_global_timeout.description: Timeout the run would actually use; exceeds the requested one when auto-contention raised it.

budget_ok.description: The requested timeout covers `gated_seconds` without an auto-raise, or `--allow-under-budget` is set.

default_global_timeout.description: Compiled-in default, echoed so an agent can tell an explicit value from the default.

product_snapshot.title: DeepResearchBudgetProductSnapshot
product_snapshot.description: The 14-key snapshot `budget::print::default_product_snapshot` attaches to every `--probe` and `--probe-deep` envelope (CM-10). It is NOT the `--print-budget` envelope: that one carries 27 keys plus the `deep_research_budget` discriminator, while this one is a compiled-in default with no discriminator and no runtime overrides. The two shapes were conflated until v1.0.4, when `probe-deep-output.schema.json` was found declaring 12 of these keys inline behind `additionalProperties: true`, so `runtime_dual_multiproc` and `parallelism` rode along undeclared. Defined once here and `$ref`d by both probe schemas, so the shape cannot drift per file again.

runtime_dual_multiproc.description: Whether the dual vertical actually runs as two Chrome processes at this parallelism.
